diagnosis: The RevokeInvite handler extracts the inviteID parameter using gorilla/mux and revokes the invitation without verifying that the authenticated caller has administrative rights over the workspace associated with the invitation. An authenticated member of any workspace can revoke invitations belonging to arbitrary organizations, causing disruption to team onboarding.
